Remote non-test payload manifests require a provisioned known Ed25519 key, matching fingerprint and valid canonical Unicode signature. Unsigned admission requires test channel or both local manifest and local payloads.

Every committed and reused file has its declared size and actual SHA256; only all-verified bytes earn a complete receipt and exact completion counters. Corrupt hashes retry once then discard corrupt partial bytes; oversized sources and errors are durably failed.
Partial bytes are resumed with HTTP Range or local seeking; completed files with matching receipt identity, size, timestamp and actual SHA256 are reused without another download.
A consumed pause request stops at a progress boundary, persists paused status and retains resumable partial bytes; another run finishes verified staging.
Add-on installs run in detached workers, keep separate per-pack status and receipts, expose stagedOnly=true, and never change base-pack status. Installed means every staged file still verifies.
Unknown IDs are rejected; unavailable payloads disclose their gap. Mismatched, broken or missing manifests fail without a target; repairing the manifest clears errors and permits staging.
